scope: Complete executable 26-channel causal replay input rule and small-scale offline-training-builder versus stateful runtime-adapter parity. No UAV model, training, score tuning, full cache rebuild, final-test/Real access or deployment activation.
fit_selection: Lexicographically first frozen train no_fault case per SIL/HIL x six flight modes. Timing only, no labels or model scores used to set limits. Original crop timestamps only.
validation_selection: Lexicographically first val no_fault case per SIL/HIL plus both already documented train/val inertial-gap counterexamples. Selection fixed before timing results; no replacing hard cases.
sample_clock: Keep original crop origin and 20ms grid. ULog timestamp is replay availability proxy only. Use timestamp_sample when provided and valid; sensor_combined gyro uses publication proxy and acceleration uses timestamp plus accelerometer_timestamp_relative. Missing/invalid observation clock fails the message; no silent fallback to publication time. Group clocks must be monotonic.
age_recipe: For each canonical observation group, take largest per-case median positive publication interval across fit cases plus largest per-case median publication-minus-observation lag plus one 20000us grid tick; ceil to 20000us. One nominal update period plus one scheduler tick and nominal sensor lag. Do not use maxima of outages, validation coverage, fault labels, predictions or test scores to widen limits. This is an explicit pilot engineering hold budget, not validated physical detection tolerance or deployment certification.
validation: Use frozen pilot limits unchanged on validation and gap examples. Compare selected source indices, availability and observation times, ages, missing/stale/nonfinite masks, canonical rows and every eligible normalized 150-frame window; full raw prefix versus replay receives only already available messages. Test fixed synthetic late arrivals, duplicates, invalid latest values, missing topics, stale recovery, event-order errors, and counterexample future truncation.
normalization: Fit small-scale diagnostic normalization on valid source fit windows only using causal inputs and fixed cap64 identities. Freeze for both paths. It is not production normalization and never updates historical stats. If any channel has zero variance, use explicit unit scale and record that channel. Validation/final-test/Real not used for fitting.
invalid_policy: Retain all rows/window IDs with validity and reason masks. No zero/back/future fill, arbitrary deletion, resampling extra members or treating unavailable as normal/fault. Windows require all necessary input rows valid; labels remain separate and no model forward occurs.
live_boundary: Existing telemetry snapshot cannot certify per-topic source/receive times. New explicit adapter rejects incomplete clock provenance; it is not installed into old deployment. Physical link timing and eligibility remain blocked even if replay parity passes.
